verdicts.reason: A is broken: the subhead 'with your next cup of coffee' is blown up larger than the tiny 'GET A GIFT' headline, so the hierarchy is inverted. That subhead sits directly on the busy sweater photo, and dashed rules, oversized stars, gift icons, 'Only this Christmas' and the URL are scattered across the photo. B keeps the original vertical stack intact and in order, but shrinks it into a narrow centre column with tiny text ('Only this Christmas', the URL and the stars are barely legible). It leaves a large empty pink area on the left and ignores the left-to-right banner format, but it has no collisions and stays on brand.
